requirements.text: Implement real-time transaction alerts to notify customers of purchases, including amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
Include budgeting tools that allow users to set personal spending limits in various categories and receive alerts when approaching those limits.
Integrate fingerprint and facial recognition for secure and convenient biometric authentication during the app login process.
Provide in-app lending options that allow customers to apply for personal loans or overdraft increases, with pre-filled forms and real-time application status updates.
Ensure compliance with PSD2 regulations for Strong Customer Authentication.
Ensure GDPR compliance by storing customer financial data within the European Economic Area.
Maintain integration with the existing core banking system without major changes to the mainframe.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the current app version for at least six months during the transition.
